messages:
marta: Heads up: H1000 shipment delayed at FRA for thermal inspections. Vendor offered two paths: (1) expedited air (3-4w) at +$5k/unit, (2) staged sea release with 7% buffer and provisional QA batch in 2w. Need decision for our EU cluster rollout. @oliver_vendor, can depot pre-scan serials into manifest?
oliver_vendor: We can pre-scan and provide a machine-readable manifest (CSV) with serials; FRA depot will hold until manifest confirmation. We recommend path (2) unless you need capacity this month. Historical DOA 0.9%. We can add 4% buffer. Expedited fee is service-only and outside price-protection.
jess: If we take staged release, what's the onboarding runbook? We should auto-flag any serial mismatches and quarantine units. Also finance needs invoice preview for both options.
ops-bot: Ticket INC-2026-3420 created: "H1000 thermal inspect delay + choose release path" assigned infra/ops. Link: https://redwood.internal/INC-2026-3420
marta: We'll await the vendor manifest and finance draft; prefer staged release unless customer impact is high.
